## BodyBox  (type-only)
interface BodyBox {
    half: number;
    height: number;
    eye: number;
}

## CalibrateWhy  (type-only)
type CalibrateWhy = 'start' | 'reset' | 'asked' | 'mode';

## ComponentLayout  (type-only)
interface ComponentLayout {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly button: number;
    readonly xAxis: number;
    readonly yAxis: number;
    readonly responses: readonly ResponseLayout[];
}

## ControllerHand  (type-only)
type ControllerHand = 'left' | 'right';

## ControllerLayout  (type-only)
interface ControllerLayout {
    readonly profile: string;
    readonly hand: ControllerHand;
    readonly assetPath: string;
    readonly components: readonly ComponentLayout[];
    readonly responses: readonly ResponseLayout[];
    readonly parts: Readonly<Record<ControllerPart, number>>;
}

## ControllerPart  (type-only)
type ControllerPart = 'trigger' | 'grip' | 'stick' | 'a' | 'b' | 'x' | 'y';

## ProfileJson  (type-only)
interface ProfileJson {
    profileId: string;
    layouts: Record<string, {
        rootNodeName?: string;
        assetPath?: string;
        components: Record<string, {
            type?: string;
            gamepadIndices?: {
                button?: number;
                xAxis?: number;
                yAxis?: number;
            };
            visualResponses?: Record<string, {
                componentProperty: string;
                states: string[];
                valueNodeProperty: string;
                valueNodeName: string;
                minNodeName?: string;
                maxNodeName?: string;
            }>;
        }>;
    }>;
}
